resources.string: Tips
Try it
Open Settings
What\'s new in MesOS %1$s
A new look: Aurora wallpaper, new icons, fonts and motion everywhere
Home with pages, folders, widgets, drag and drop and search
Control center with toggles, sliders, media and notifications
Settings 2.0 with search, and a setup wizard
New apps: Clock, Calendar, Weather, Music, Recorder, Scanner, Contacts, Phone, Messages, Browser, Device Care and Tips
MesOS checks for updates once a day and asks before installing
Home
MesOS apps
Privacy and updates
Pull down for the control center
Swipe down anywhere on Home for Wi‑Fi, Bluetooth, flashlight, brightness, what is playing and your notifications.
Swipe up to find anything
All your apps, plus search across apps, contacts, notes and settings. Type a sum like 12x4 to calculate.
Make Home yours
Long-press empty space to edit. Drag icons around, drop one icon on another to make a folder, or drag to the edge for a new page.
Widgets at a glance
Clock, weather, today\'s events, notes and battery, plus widgets from apps you install from Google Play.
Aurora, your way
Pick a wallpaper, an accent colour and an icon shape. Aurora can also be your lock screen.
Scan codes
Point the camera at a QR code or barcode. MesOS shows what is inside before anything opens; Wi‑Fi codes join the network.
Record your voice or the screen
Recordings keep going in the background. Screen recording starts from the control center too.
Alarms that ring on time
Repeating alarms, world clocks, a stopwatch with laps and a timer that shows in notifications.
Weather where you are
Hourly and 10-day forecasts for your location and any city you add.
Your music
Songs, albums and artists on this device, with controls on the lock screen and in the control center.
Keep an eye on your device
Battery health, storage and memory with a clear score and honest advice.
You decide who sees what
Settings → Privacy & permissions lists every permission and special access, and lets you change them.
Safe MesOS updates
Updates come from the MesOS GitHub releases over HTTPS, are checked (SHA-256 and signature) and install only when you confirm.
Türkçe or English
MesOS can use its own language, separate from Android\'s.
